name: sushi-agent
description: Thin, embeddable TypeScript + Rust runtime for small production agents.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @sushi-agent/core && npm run build -w @sushi-agent/cli
scripts.check: npm run check -w @sushi-agent/core && npm run build -w @sushi-agent/core && npm run check -w @sushi-agent/cli
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sushi-agent/core && npm run test -w @sushi-agent/cli && cargo test --workspace
